text_block_list.text:
"Let's go to Dubai together"...
A few weeks had passed since those
shocking words.
Now I was here watching a mock race.
The reason being――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
――Trainer-san,
won't you make a contract with me?
And take me all the way to Dubai♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... wait a second,
Vivlos. Don't tell me
you only just came up with that right now?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way~! Not true at all!
Besides, Trainer-san is super nice,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Stayed with me the whole time I was
shopping!
I just looooove kind people like
Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry,
Trainer-san. I'll make sure to speak with
her properly later... Listen, Vivlos,
choosing a trainer means――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, I get it already!
Trainer-san,
I really want someone just like you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I just say?
Because you're nice!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To me,
that's super important!
Nothing wrong with that, right?
Everyone has different criteria,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, you probably don't know if I'm any good,
right?
Then come watch my next mock race!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll totally show you how good I am!
Bye-bye for today,
let's play again soon, okay? Onee-chan,
let's grab food!

――Since an Umamusume invited me directly,
there was no reason
not to go.
I was genuinely curious about her abilities,
but first...

Dubai hosts multiple prestigious international
G1 races.
Elite stages where top Umamusume gather from
all over the world.

In recent years,
several Japanese Umamusume broke through to
win there,
and Dubai races have been drawing massive
domestic spotlight.

If Vivlos truly wants to race in Dubai,
challenging that together
as her trainer would be an absolute honor.
But――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You really came!
Heeey, Tore-cchi♪

...For some reason,
she was acting like we were lifelong
besties.
There had to be a real reason someone so
young was fixated on Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my absolute best!
Don't look away for a second, okay?
Keep your eyes only on me~!

And so, the mock race with Vivlos began,
however――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm♪

Vivlos got off to a clean start and joined
the lead pack.
Her racing instincts were razor-sharp,
naturally finding the best position.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, looking right at me,
aren't they...♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Guess I gotta show off even more good stuff
then!
Yaaaaaaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Tore-cchi~~~~!
Aren't I amazing~~~~!

Surging past the pack in the home stretch,
she seized absolute victory.
A completely one-sided display――

With the right guidance,
her ceiling could be limitless.
As a trainer,
my heart pounded with excitement――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――Vivlos has... always been like that.

Suddenly,
Verxina's little sister appeared beside
me――
Vivlos' other older sister, Cheval Grand.

Currently running in the Twinkle Series,
she had yet to score big results,
but her latent potential was undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
With her natural instincts,
she can do anything effortlessly.
Unlike someone clumsy like me...
she's entirely different...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ah, s-sorry...!

...I wanted to ask more about Vivlos,
but seemed to startle her.
Right then――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Tore-cchi~~~~!
You were just talking with Chevacchi,
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Did she say anything about me?
Did she talk about me?
Did she praise me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Chevacchi really said that...?
...Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, Tore-cchi?
My running was awesome, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Totally was, right~♪
So you'll be my trainer now, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still no?
Trainer's job is helping an Umamusume win,
right?
If I already run great,
isn't that totally perfect?
choice_data_list: But I don't know anything about you
But I don't know anything about you

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm~...
Tore-cchi, what else do you wanna know?

Having seen her skills,
the other crucial piece was her "dream".
What drove her,
why she ran... The only hint was――
choice_data_list: You're aiming to race in Dubai?
You're aiming to race in Dubai?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly!
Running in that race is my dream!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You've seen races in Dubai,
right? So super sparkly,
packed with huge celebs!
Absolute best vibe ever~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, yeah!
That's pretty much it... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san, wanna know more, right?
Ask me anything! Ah,
but who I crush on is~ a secret♡
choice_data_list: (I know her dream, then after this……)

text_block_list.text:
Her talent was undeniable,
but raw talent alone wouldn't conquer
Dubai.
Without a clear training vision yet,
I couldn't sign a contract on the spot.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I need to think this through!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh?!
Why thoooough~~~~?!
